reason: I need somewhere indoors to burn an hour between naps, and $12 with a drink included is fair for that. I'd try it as a drop-in a couple of times, not commit to a membership.
objection: I'll still be chasing my kid around, so I won't really get to sit and drink the coffee. And with daycare costs up, $59 a month is a commitment I can't justify until I know we'd actually go often enough.
would_change_my_mind: A free or cheap trial visit, or a multi-visit pass with no monthly commitment, would get me to spend more. A membership would only work if I knew we'd go at least weekly.
